ai_summary: Aaron Industries Limited has secured a significant domestic order from Gulf Elevators Private Limited for the supply of up to 30 EVOQ360 Home Lifts. This contract is valued at an estimated INR 2 Crore (exclusive of GST) and is to be executed by September 30, 2027, representing a material positive revenue stream for the company. Notably, the document confirms no related party transactions or promoter interests, indicating an arm's length business deal with no immediate red flags.
